source.author: ov
source.text: Utque manu late pendentia nubila pressit, fit fragor: hinc densi funduntur ab aethere nimbi.
source.text_original: Utque manu late pendentia nubila pressit, / fit fragor: hinc densi funduntur ab aethere nimbi.
source.text_english: And when he pressed with his hand the clouds hanging far and wide, there was a crash; then thick showers pour down from the sky.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Fit fragor; irrumpunt foribus qui saeva ferebant imperia et strictos iussis regalibus enses.
reuse.text_original: Fit fragor; irrumpunt foribus qui saeva ferebant / imperia et strictos iussis regalibus enses.
reuse.text_english: A crash arises; those who brought savage orders and swords drawn at the royal command burst in through the doors.
